method: Tool view_image inspection of all five actual PNG/Canvas outputs; three scenes reviewed again with the integrated painted Nacre panorama
observations: All 28 source cells remain separated and readable; no adjacent cell is included.
Living and lost poses keep their natural proportions and the measured ground baseline.
All three mission scenes use the real painted Nacre panorama; no empty image edge or stretched background is visible.
MI07 driver and medic silhouettes and their role labels remain readable against the water in the personnel scene.

MI06 technicians and MI07 patient trolleys appear at the existing simulated positions. In locking and transfer scenes, some small bodies and labels overlap the walker legs or ambulance; the background adds no observed obstruction but does not resolve these local foreground overlaps.
Full scenes preserve original small-scale figures; source-cell and grounding boards provide the enlarged material review.
open: Human animation review and new native browser reception remain separate.
Individual figures can be difficult to distinguish during local overlaps with vehicles at the existing game scale.
